svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: kids clothing before and after the Ontario 8 percent rebate
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. $400 of qualifying children's clothing is invented. Ontario's published rebate is 8 percent of the provincial portion. Eight percent of $400 is $32, so $368 remains. Not a household average.
svg.text: Example: Ontario rebate on qualifying clothes
Example with made-up inputs. The $400 is not a budget target. The 8 percent is Ontario's rule.
Apply 8 percent only to items that meet Ontario's size rules. Cleats and adult sizes do not.
Saving Optimizer, 29 Sep 2026. Ontario page updated 19 Mar 2025. Not a store price.
